question: After selecting #requestProfile=audit, #statusFilter=open and #regionFilter=west, filling #minAmount with 500, filling #ownerInput with maria, checking #agedOnly, clicking #stageRequest, clicking the next-page table action, clicking the save-columns table action, and finally clicking #prepareRequest, locate the anchor function for the request_payload field in the console.log object whose action is table.filter.request. The anchor function is the first target-specific request-transformation value-construction function on the dynamic behavior chain: after delegated click routing, action dispatch, form collection, normalization, visual scope calculation, stage ticket creation, page/layout mutation, stage reconciliation, hydration, async queueing and resolver dispatch, its own function body constructs the observable request_payload value (an object with method, endpoint, profile, stage and a body holding filters, projection, page, sort, hydration and matched scope) rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, packaging an already built value, or emitting it to the console sink. The target field name and action are assembled from character-code arrays at the sink, so direct literal search in the captured bundles is insufficient. Return exactly one complete function as a single JSON object (see answer_format). Do not return a generic helper, event handler, router, staging wrapper, hydration bridge, the full call chain, the final console sink, or a decoy table action. Note: the code you can inspect is limited to the captured corpus under captures; the full source tree is not part of the default answer space.

function_name.description: The identifier on the function declaration line in the captured bundle slice (the name immediately after the `function` keyword). Use the name as it appears in captures, not a guessed source-level name.

file.description: Path to the JavaScript file under captures/ that contains the function (the app bundle or the lazy request transformation core chunk). Must match visible_corpus.

slice.description: One contiguous source slice covering exactly one complete function body in the captured bundle.

start_line.description: 1-based inclusive start line of the function in file.

end_line.description: 1-based inclusive end line of the function in file.

start_offset.description: 0-based byte offset in file where the function slice begins.

end_offset.description: 0-based byte offset in file where the function slice ends (exclusive).

code.description: Exact source text of the complete function from start_offset to end_offset. Must start with `function <function_name>(` and end with the closing brace of that function.

slice.code: function exampleAnchorFn(envelope) { const shape = pickExampleShape(envelope); return { method: "POST", endpoint: "/example", profile: envelope.profile, body: { filters: exampleFilters(envelope) } }; }

Submit exactly one JSON object matching answer_format.response_schema; do not wrap it in markdown fences unless the evaluation harness explicitly requires that.
